market_summary: Overall market exhibits strong USD momentum and broad market dispersion during the London/NY overlap session. FX pairs (EURUSD, GBPUSD) and XAUUSD are in aggressive downward trends below their respective VWAPs and Value Areas, but are heavily stretched near ATR lower bounds and local session lows. US100 displays clear bullish expansion above VAH and EMA baselines, presenting a high-confluence long scalp setup.

signals.rationale: Price at 4002.98 is below VAL (4033.66) and below POC (4043.60). CVD is NEUTRAL (-1.08) with slight positive slope. Session is LONDON_NY_OVERLAP. Price broke well below VWAP (4041.66) and EMA50 (4039.11), penetrating below the lower ATR band (4013.59). RVOL spike occurred on the breakdown candle 5 bars ago. Given extreme stretch below lower ATR band and test of Session Low (4000.54), setup is extended for a safe sell entry.
